# Chapter 17 — Postselected Closed Timelike Curves (P-CTC) versus D-CTC: Two Maps, Two m-qg Readouts and the Shot Price {#sec-qjax17 .unnumbered}

**Updated:** November 22, 2026

> Rewrite of the old Ch. 14 on the basis of Ch. 1–16. Module: `qang.qctc` (JAX, `jax<0.9`; aligned with `qang.postselection`, §164). Verification: `tools/verify_cap17.py`. The **maps** are simulated; the physical existence of CTCs is `unverified` and is not claimed.

---

## 17.1 The two maps

Let $U$ be the interaction between the chronology-respecting qubit CR and the CTC qubit.
$$\text{P-CTC (Lloyd):}\quad \rho\mapsto\frac{C\rho C^\dagger}{\mathrm{Tr}(C\rho C^\dagger)},\ \ C=\mathrm{Tr}_{\text{CTC}}U,\ \ p_{\text{post}}=\tfrac14\mathrm{Tr}(C\rho C^\dagger);\qquad \text{D-CTC (Deutsch):}\quad \rho_{\text{CTC}}=\mathrm{Tr}_{\text{CR}}\big[U(\rho\otimes\rho_{\text{CTC}})U^\dagger\big].$$
P-CTC is the teleportation of Ch. 15 with the Bell measurement **postselected**: it costs one Bell pair (2 qubits) and $\times1/p_{\text{post}}$ shots. D-CTC is a nonlinear fixed point (iteration from $I/2$, maximum-entropy selection) with no single-circuit analogue. Both are simulated as maps and read in m-qg.

## 17.2 Three interactions, read in m-qg

| $U$ | $C=\mathrm{Tr}_{\text{CTC}}U$ | P-CTC | $p_{\text{post}}$ | D-CTC |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| $I$ | $2I$ | identity | $1$ | identity |
| CNOT (CR controls CTC) | $2|0\rangle\langle0|$ | **projects** to $+1000$ m-qg, any input | $(1+qg_Z)/2$ | keeps $qg_Z$, **erases** $qg_X,qg_Y$ (1 iteration) |
| SWAP | $I$ | identity | $1/4$ | identity ($\rho_{\text{CTC}}=\rho$) |
| $(X\otimes I)\,$SWAP | $X$ | $\rho\mapsto X\rho X$ ($qg_Y,qg_Z\to-$) | $1/4$ | — |

CNOT instance: input $-980$ m-qg → P-CTC $+1000$ m-qg with $p_{\text{post}}=0.010$ ($\times100$ shots); D-CTC $-980$ m-qg with $qg_X\to0$. The nonlinearity of P-CTC is paid for in the budget: $N\propto1/p_{\text{post}}=2/(1+qg_Z)$, divergent at the pole $|1\rangle$ (`exact` for the map).

## 17.3 Operational contrast

| Metric | Standard | `qang` (`qang.qctc` + JAX) | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| P-CTC resources | — | 1 Bell pair + postselection $\times1/p_{\text{post}}$ | `exact` (count) |
| D-CTC resources | — | fixed-point iteration (converged in $\le2$ it. in all 3 cases) | `exact` sim. |
| Discriminating reading | tomography | $qg_Z$ and $qg_X$ of CR: P-CTC moves $qg_Z$, D-CTC kills $qg_X$ | `exact` |
| Physical CTCs | — | — | `unverified` |

## 17.4 JAX block (`qang/qctc.py`)

```python
def pctc_operator(U):                            # C = Tr_CTC(U)
    return U.reshape(2, 2, 2, 2).trace(axis1=1, axis2=3)

def pctc_map(rho, U):                            # (ρ_out, p_post)
    C = pctc_operator(U); M = C @ rho @ jnp.conj(C).T
    return M / jnp.trace(M), jnp.real(jnp.trace(M)) / 4.0

def dctc_map(rho, U, iters=200):                 # fixed point from I/2
    rho_ctc = I2 / 2
    for k in range(iters):
        new = ptrace_first(U @ jnp.kron(rho, rho_ctc) @ jnp.conj(U).T)
        if float(jnp.max(jnp.abs(new - rho_ctc))) < 1e-14: rho_ctc = new; break
        rho_ctc = new
    return ptrace_second(U @ jnp.kron(rho, rho_ctc) @ jnp.conj(U).T), rho_ctc, k + 1
```

## 17.5 Verification — `tools/verify_cap17.py`

```
[1] U=I: P-CTC and D-CTC = identity; p_post = 1
[2] input  -980 m-qg: P-CTC → +1000 m-qg, p_post=0.010 (shots ×100.0) | D-CTC → -980 m-qg, qg_X→0, fixed point in 1 it.
[3] U=SWAP: P-CTC identity with p_post=0.25 (×4 shots) | D-CTC identity, ρ_CTC=ρ in 2 it.
[4] U=(X⊗I)SWAP: C = X → ρ → XρX, p_post=0.25
verify_cap17: OK
```
Asserts: $C_{\text{CNOT}}=2|0\rangle\langle0|$; P-CTC $qg_Z\to1$ to $10^{-13}$ and $p_{\text{post}}=(1+qg_Z)/2$ to $10^{-14}$; D-CTC keeps $qg_Z$ and nulls $qg_X$ to $10^{-13}$; SWAP: both identity, $p_{\text{post}}=1/4$.

### `tests/test_qctc.py`
```python
import pytest; jax = pytest.importorskip("jax")
import numpy as np, jax.numpy as jnp
from qang.qctc import pctc_map, dctc_map, bloch, state_from_bloch, CNOT, SWAP

def test_cnot_pctc_projects_dctc_decoheres():
    rho = state_from_bloch(jnp.array([0.4, 0.0, -0.6]))
    op, p = pctc_map(rho, CNOT); od, _, _ = dctc_map(rho, CNOT)
    assert abs(float(bloch(op)[2]) - 1) < 1e-13 and abs(float(p) - 0.2) < 1e-14
    assert abs(float(bloch(od)[2]) + 0.6) < 1e-13 and abs(float(bloch(od)[0])) < 1e-13

def test_swap_identity():
    rho = state_from_bloch(jnp.array([0.3, -0.4, 0.5])); op, p = pctc_map(rho, SWAP)
    assert np.allclose(np.asarray(bloch(op)), [0.3, -0.4, 0.5], atol=1e-14) and abs(float(p) - 0.25) < 1e-14
```
